episodes.title: Final Call
episodes.summary: Sam Nelson gets on a flight to London hoping to win back his ex-wife, but something on board feels wrong - and his suspicions are confirmed.

episodes.title: 3 Degrees
episodes.summary: Spotting an opportunity, Sam executes a plan to get a covert message to authorities on the ground.

episodes.title: Draw a Blank
episodes.summary: As the UK's counterterrorism unit learns of Flight KA29, Sam gets involved in a risky plan to take on the hijackers.

episodes.title: Not Responding
episodes.summary: An incident team in Westminster scrambles to intercept fighter jets. Sam tries contacting the ground once more when a hijacker is injured.

episodes.title: Less Than an Hour
episodes.summary: Sam attempts to convince the hijackers to land the plane. A list of demands reveals who's behind the hijacking.

episodes.title: Comply Slowly
episodes.summary: Faced with an impossible decision, the passengers ready themselves for a fight.

episodes.title: Brace Brace Brace
episodes.summary: Season finale. A new threat emerges on board as Sam struggles to control the chaos unfolding around him.

episodes.title: Signal
episodes.summary: Two years after Flight KA29's hijacking, Sam Nelson is thrust into another life-threatening ordeal—but this time it's personal.

episodes.title: Control
episodes.summary: Sam urges Otto to keep his cool as passengers begin to suspect something is wrong. Police Chief Winter races to mount a response.

episodes.title: Baggage
episodes.summary: Berlin police scramble to contain the situation. Sam pressures Winter to meet his demands. Marsha discovers she's being watched.

episodes.title: Switch
episodes.summary: A shocking turn of events forces Sam to make a gesture of good faith. In London, Daniel calls on a friend to help look into what's happening in Berlin.

episodes.title: Outage
episodes.summary: Anger and frustration among the passengers begin to boil over—just as Sam comes to a frightening realization.

episodes.title: Junction
episodes.summary: To avoid further disaster, Sam must work with an unlikely ally. The enemy closes in on Marsha as Zahra and Daniel fear they've reached a dead end.

episodes.title: Contact
episodes.summary: Sam gambles on a dangerous tactic in hopes of outsmarting the police. Armed with new intel, Olivia tries to influence Winter's next move.

episodes.title: Terminal
episodes.summary: Season finale. With the handover imminent, Sam is prepared to put his life on the line to save Marsha—and expose the truth.
